path-plan.json.control: seeded Gaussian direction matched to actual BF16 residual-change L2 within 1%; invalid matches retained, not promoted
path-plan.json.scope: 96 existing long natural contexts. Local next-MLP response and next-token loss/argmax; not semantic identification or complete ability-preservation proof.
path-plan.json.selection: Top4 source parent usage counts per pair, discovery-only predictor, deterministic tie break.
path-plan.json.zero_edit: Native suffix logits must match original final-position logits within max abs 0.001 before intervention.

plan.json.dtype: BF16 native bits; derived statistics FP32/FP64
plan.json.evidence: Correlations and weight compatibility are not causal paths; semantic labels remain candidate/unknown until tested.
plan.json.exposure: Existing long-context bank used previously. Heldout means not fitted by this new estimator; not globally blind or new materials.
plan.json.method: Native gate/up/product poles and four sign regimes; all-unit weight alignment and context associations; frozen sparse adjacent-layer predictor plus three-step rollout.
plan.json.prediction_inputs: Observed B32 native A for rollout; observed previous-layer A for one-step. Target states, future tokens and heldout labels unavailable to fitting.

baselines: token means (>=8 discovery occurrences) with language/position fallback
prediction-plan.json.exposure: Existing bank held out from this estimator only. Not a new independent semantic confirmation.
prediction-plan.json.fit: Per target ridge with discovery-normalized source A and lambda=.01*n; fit G,V,A separately, same selected parents.

implementation_revision.reason: Complete the already specified additive position fallback before any fitting or score inspection; selection and thresholds unchanged.

prediction-plan.json.primary: Paired document-bootstrap FVU improvement over token baseline, confirm/holdout separate; 98.3333% CIs for 3 adjacent pairs.
prediction-plan.json.rollout: Observed B32 A only, then recursively predicted A33--A35; direct linear and composed SiLU(Ghat)*Vhat compared.
prediction-plan.json.selection: Largest absolute discovery A-to-A Pearson coefficients per target; all full matrices retained.

profile-implementation.json.reason: Available RAM约7.7GiB，按256单元分块计算，统计式/划分/阈值不变；开始前记录。
